text: Employees receive 24 days of paid leave per year.
Employees can take up to 10 days of sick leave per year.
Employees receive 12 days of casual leave per year.
Employees work from the office on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.
Monday and Friday are optional work-from-home days.
Employees must work from the office at least three days per week.
Employees receive Rs 3000 per month for gym reimbursement.
Employees can claim Rs 2000 per month for home internet.
Employees can claim up to Rs 5000 per year for medical expenses.
Employees have a 90 day notice period.
Employees become eligible for promotion after completing one year in their current role.
Employees can apply for internal job openings after six months in their current position.
Employees must mark their attendance before starting work each day.
Employees are expected to complete at least eight working hours each day.
Employees must inform their manager if they are unable to attend work.
Employees receive health insurance coverage as part of their benefits.
Employees receive life insurance coverage as part of their employee benefits.
Employees receive meal benefits during regular working days.
Employees can participate in technical training programs to improve their skills.
Employees can attend communication and leadership training sessions.
Employees can request training courses related to their current job responsibilities.
